method: static read-only review; no execution/network/model calls; no re-run of the sealed single-model pilot

defects.title: Lease file leaks if write fails after O_EXCL create
defects.failing_input: os.fdopen/json.dump/os.fsync raises after os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL) succeeds (e.g. disk full, permission revoked mid-write)
defects.impact: orphaned .lock file blocks every future APISpendEnvelope on that journal_path, even after process exit, with no code path to clear it
defects.fix: wrap the os.fdopen write block in try/except that unlinks the lease path and re-raises
defects.test: monkeypatch os.fdopen to raise after os.open succeeds; assert the .lock file does not exist afterward

defects.title: Silent double reservation on CallBudget identity mismatch
defects.failing_input: OpenAIModelBackend constructed with a CallBudget object that is config-equal but not `is` the binding's budget object
defects.impact: every model call reserves against two separate counters instead of raising, silently doubling the effective per-run cap
defects.fix: assert backend.call_budget is call_budget at construction/binding time and raise ValueError on mismatch, instead of branching silently at call time via getattr identity check
defects.test: construct binding with two distinct-but-equal CallBudget instances; assert construction fails rather than double-reserving on first model call

defects.title: ArchivedWebsiteProvider instance state unsynchronized under concurrency>1
defects.failing_input: two threads call provider.search()/_get(same_url) concurrently when RunRequest.concurrency>1 and a single provider instance is shared across specialist tasks
defects.impact: TOCTOU race on self._request_count can exceed max_requests; TOCTOU race on self._responses cache can issue a duplicate physical HTTP call and a duplicate 'search' budget reservation for one logical URL, contradicting the sequential-only dedup proof in test_repeated_lookup_does_not_repeat_http_or_invent_new_evidence
defects.fix: add a Lock around the check-increment in _get and around cache get/insert, mirroring CallBudget's locking pattern; or explicitly document/enforce single-threaded-only provider instances
defects.test: two threads calling the same URL through a fake client with an internal barrier; assert exactly one physical call and no max_requests overrun

defects.title: decode_as rejects a schema-conformant integer for a float field
defects.impact: a fully valid JSON Schema {"type":"number"} response using an integer-valued number fails closed with BudgetStopped('API_INVALID_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT'), no refund; currently latent because no shipped dataclass declares a float field
defects.fix: add `if kind is float and type(value) is int: return float(value)` before the strict type(value) is not kind check; keep bool rejected for int/float kinds
defects.test: decode_as(float, 10) == 10.0; decode_as(float, True) still raises ValueError

verified_correct.claim: at most one alternate capture is followed; alternate must match the same original URL and a different timestamp; alternate timestamp is independently re-verified via a fresh exact CDX query (not trusted from Location header); admitted fact is labeled with the alternate's own when/served_capture, never the originally requested capture's time
verified_correct.evidence: archive_transport.py:_replay allow_reindex flag + regex match[2]!=original/match[1]==ts rejection + _capture(...,exact_timestamp=match[1]) reverification; test_alternate_capture_requires_new_index_check_and_uses_actual_date

verified_correct.claim: as_of/deadline must be timezone-aware at RunRequest construction; CDX timestamps constrained to 14 digits and parsed with strptime (invalid calendar dates fail closed); Memento-Datetime is mandatory and must equal both the CDX-selected when and the requested replay URL before admission
verified_correct.evidence: contracts.py:aware/RunRequest.__post_init__; archive_transport.py:_capture regex + strptime; archive_transport.py:_replay served!=when or response.url!=requested check

verified_correct.claim: provider-level max_requests cap is checked before CallBudget.reserve('search'), so a capped/rejected request never consumes a budget slot
verified_correct.evidence: archive_transport.py:_get request_count check precedes call_budget.reserve; test_provider_request_cap_is_enforced, test_each_http_request_reserved_before_dispatch

verified_correct.claim: transport/CDX/decode failures produce distinct attempt statuses and are never coerced into a business conclusion; provider SDK errors are redacted before re-raising

known_limitations_not_defects: no liveness check on the .lock lease file; a crashed process leaves a stale lease blocking future runs on that journal until manually cleared
domain-anchor matching ignores port and is caller-supplied cohort metadata, not independently verified ownership (already documented in ArchivedWebsiteProvider docstring)
APISpendEnvelope/ArchiveHTTPClient are trusted in-process Python components, not an OS sandbox; recorded dollar figures are conservative estimates, not the provider's actual invoice
excluded_by_instruction: no re-run or re-pricing of the already-sealed single-model pilot
no repetition of already-fixed R004 concurrency/guard findings outside this transport/budget scope
